new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sizeExpectation_succ_cons
new_declarations.header:
theorem sizeExpectation_succ_cons (time k : Nat) (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    sizeExpectation (time + 1) k (head :: tail) =
      ∑ i : Fin (tail.length + 1), RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length i *
        match (stepRun k (head :: tail) i).1 with
        | Sum.inl (j, ys) => sizeExpectation time j ys
        | Sum.inr _ => 0

    residualExpectation (w + 1) k (head :: tail) =
      ∑ i : Fin (tail.length + 1), RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length i *
        match (stepRun k (head :: tail) i).1 with
        | Sum.inl (j, ys) => residualExpectation w j ys
        | Sum.inr _ => 0

mathematical_statement_review.assessment: activeSize reads the actual indexed trace entry and returns0 after exhaustion. residualWork is exactly scanVolume(drop w trace). Pure list lemmas prove finite-size summation, absorption after trace length, positive entries, pointwise bounded observation, exact take/drop decomposition, residual<=total, and prefix<=w*n given the explicitly stated per-entry bound. Those generic list hypotheses are discharged from run_trace_entries in execution theorems; they do not assume desired probability or complexity.

Supported actual runs have first size=input length, sizes<=initial length, zero exactly when the finite actual trace ends, persistent zero afterwards, and all observations vanish by time n. The existing run_active_calls_le and positive trace entries supply termination facts. Initial prefixes cost<=w*n, so W>=(4+w)*n implies residual>=4*n. All statements cover empty and invalid worker extensions as applicable; no unrelated process replaces stepRun/run.

sizeExpectation and residualExpectation are weighted observations of the existing run. Empty observations are0, initial size expectation is n, and residual at0 is the previously checked scanExpectation. Both successor recurrences follow workExpectation_cons and actual prepend; the equal branch is0 and the recursive branch uses the actual selected (rank,list) child under the same fresh current-occurrence uniform weights.

Natural-time induction plus checked nextSize_drift gives E[X_j]<=q^j*n and E[R_w]<=4*q^w*n with q=3/4. The base residual bound is checked E[W]<=4n. Neither independence nor a target bound is an assumption. Exact absorption also gives zero expectations after n. Residual expectation<=actual scan expectation establishes finite lower expectation independently of cancellation at the tail threshold.

residualLaw is the Nat pushforward of actual residualWork, not an assigned cost distribution. Its support lies within the same triangular actual scan bound and is finite. The lower integral is proved equal to residualExpectation using the private standard PMF map/tsum bridge. Existing finite expectation supplies real integrability with no measurable, finite or inhabited payload assumption.

Support-aware event transport couples scan and residual laws on the same run. Pinned standard Markov gives the non-strict >= residual event, with threshold positivity/finite Nat cast proved. The final scan tail has natural w and explicit 0<xs.length, exact threshold(4+w)*length and upper(3/4)^w. The actual source bridge T<=9W+2 proves event inclusion at9*((4+w)*length)+2 before using the scan tail. For fixed w the upper bound is fixed, so no probability->1 as n grows is claimed.

The empty scan law is actually pure0. Its proportional non-strict event has probability1 for every natural w. The explicit w1 theorem refutes the tail conclusion if positive length were omitted. The event is never changed to strict > and no stronger real-w assertion is made.
